title: About the Event – BMW BERLIN-MARATHON
claims: More world records have been broken on Berlin's fast pavement than at any other marathon race in the world: 13 so far.
Over 50,000 finishers cross the Brandenburg Gate just before the finish; millions of spectators and 80 live bands celebrate along the course.

The six-race World Marathon Majors series began in 2006 with Tokyo, Boston, London, Berlin, Chicago and New York; Sydney became the seventh member in 2025; finishers of six AbbottWMM events earn the Six Star Medal.
The event holds the World Athletics Elite Platinum Label and received the WA Heritage Plaque in November 2023; Berlin was one of the 28 AIMS founding members in 1986.
